summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K announcing a 5% increase in the exchange ratio for its voluntary exchange offer to acquire the roughly 10% of Santander Brasil it does not own, covering common shares, preferred shares, units and ADSs via concurrent Brazilian and US offers. Holders receive 0.4260 new Banco Santander shares per unit/ADS (up from 0.4056) or 0.2130 per common/preferred share (up from 0.2028), payable in newly issued BDRs or ADSs. Full acceptance implies about 166 million new shares, roughly 1.1% of capital, maximum consideration around €1.9 billion. An EGM on 15 December 2026 will seek approval of capital increases; closing is subject to regulatory approvals and no material adverse change. Watch regulatory clearances and minority tender acceptance.
